title: GROUPBY groups by a column added in the query, which has no lineage

source.quote: -- GROUPBY is useful to group by columns with no lineage -- Each column added by GROUPBY must iterate CURRENTGROUP().
source.supports: the page groups a computed column and counts with COUNTX ( CURRENTGROUP (), 1 )

derivation: Quantity per Sales row: 1, 2, 1, 5, 2, 3, 1. Large: rows 2, 4, 5, 6 = 40 + 50 + 200 + 30 = 320, 4 rows. Small: rows 1, 3, 7 = 100 + 20 + 100 = 220, 3 rows.
